title: COUNTS: Benchmarking Object Detectors and Multimodal Large Language Models under Distribution Shifts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on visual grounding tasks by providing in-context examples (ICE) that intentionally contain sampling bias. This creates false statistical associations between irrelevant visual features (like specific environmental domains, backgrounds, or lighting conditions) and object labels to see if models are misled by these spurious correlations during testing.
